past.title: Auto Club Meetup | July 4th
past.body:
(Twice Weekly) Auto Club Meetup by the Retired Cruisers Club of America

Saturday, July 4th | 7-10p

Located at 1400 S. Independence Blvd., Virginia Beach.

Hello auto family. Come out to Freedom Wash in VB for Friday and Saturday car meets. We think it will be cool to meet people in the Norfolk And Virginia beach area with ex police vehicles and some nice Hot Rodz. All different rides are welcome. Get a wash for only $5 and get a spot for you ride if you're looking to sell quick.  We are trying to recruit new members as well and we would love to get some new  supporters to help get The R.C.C name out there. if interested plz drop pic of your ride or hit us up - TY. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake | July 4th
past.body:
(1st Sat) Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake

Saturday, July 4th | 9-11am

Located at Greenbrier Mall, 1401 Greenbrier Pkwy., Chesapeake.

Monthly car meet on the 1st  Saturday of every month. All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Free coffee and doughnuts!

***UPDATE - New Location*** 

We're temporarily hosting our first Saturday events at Greenbrier Mall in Chesapeake. We will be in the lot behind the old Sears, at the back of the mall. As you enter, turn left and drive around the perimeter of the parking lot to the back where we'll be set up with the tent.

Please be respectful of the temporary location and help us keep the event going. ABSOLUTELY NO: Revving, burnouts, loud music. Be on your best behavior and respect the location.

More Info

past.title: NK Cruisers Cruise In | July 3rd
past.body:
[1st & 3rd fri] NK Cruisers Cruise In

Friday, July 3rd | 6-9p

Located at Rosie's Lot 7, 10515 Colonial Downs Pkwy., New Kent.

NK Cruisers meet the 1st and 3rd Friday 6-9p or until the last person leaves (November-March). NK Cruisers, a local car enthusiast and cruise-in group bringing the car community together between Richmond and Williamsburg. The focus is New Kent, Charles City, and Lanexa but we welcome all folks from all areas. All years, makes, models, years, cars, truck, motorcycles, golf carts, boats, tractors, and trailered vehicles always welcome. Inclement weather cancels. For more information email: nkcruisers@gmail.com and NK Cruisers Facebook page for announcements and information. www.facebook.com/groups/277456353510653/

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ | July 2nd
past.body:
(Weekly) Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ

Thursday, July 2nd | 3p

Located at Dairy Queen - 4024 Portsmouth Blvd., Chesapeake

So if you're not doing anything on Thursday afternoons get those cars out and come up to DQ. You can go in and order food and bring it out to eat. Make sure you bring a chair because they've taken the tables and chairs in. People start getting there around 2:00 and hang out for 3-4 hours or so. The weather is starting to get nice and there's not a whole lot of places we can go. This is one of the few places we can.

past.title: Doumar’s Cruise In | July 1st
past.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, July 1st | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

Be kind, clean up after yourselves, no excessive revving, and no burnouts and do not speed off when leaving their parking lot.

Hope to see you there!

More Info

past.title: Community Cruise-In | July 1st
past.body:
(Weekly) 2026 Wednesday Community Cruise In

Wednesday, July 1st | 4-7p

Located at 1317 Armory Dr., Franklin.

Join our Franklin Cruise in friends and family for the First meet of the 2026 Franklin Community Cruise-In season! Weekly cruise-ins will continue each Wednesday until October. The Franklin Independence Day Celebration with the City of Franklin and Franklin Experience will be on Saturday, July 4th with fireworks and a live band. The Grand Finale will be on Saturday, October 3, 2026. Come out and enjoy rides, fun and fellowship. Looking forward to seeing everyone there. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Topless Tuesdays | June 30th
past.body:
(Every other tues) Topless Tuesdays

Tuesday, June 30th | 5:30p-9p

Located at Garage Brewery | 1011 Eden Way, Chesapeake

Calling all Jeep owners & lovers! (O|||||||O)

This event is FREE & open to the public!
Every other Tuesday from 5:30-9pm
Jeepers get 10% OFF their tab!
Rotating Jeeps get entered to win an opportunity to park INSIDE our taproom!
Line up on our grass along Eden Way; overflow can go into a parking space.
Food Trucks rotate weekly, check our “Weekly Lineup” on IG or FB, our surrounding events here on FB, or on garage-brewery.com under “EVENTS”

Rain or Shine!
We won't judge if you aren't.. Topless

past.title: Classic Cars, Coffee, & Cones | June 27th
past.body:
(Weekly) 2026 Classic Cars, Coffee, & Cones at the Portsmouth Olde Towne Farmers Market

Saturday, june 27th | 10a-1:30p

Located at the Courthouse and High St., Portsmouth.

Join us for informal Classic Cars & Coffee at the historic Olde Towne Farmers Market every Saturday through December 20th. Classic cars get FREE up-front, car-show-style parking and FREE gourmet coffee for the drivers. Great spot to bring the spouse and family, 50+ vendors with fresh produce, grilled items, baked goods, sweets, juices, confections, even handmade jewelry and artisan items. Always something different, and very welcoming! Just flag down anyone in a yellow traffic safety vest and our deputy sheriffs will guide you to a prime spot.

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.body:
(Weekly) Colonial Car Scene Meet

Friday, June 26th | 7-10p

Located at Bruster's Real Ice Cream, 5289 John Tyler Hwy., Williamsburg.

FRIDAY! FRIDAY! FRIDAY! Friday nights, come on out and have a good time, trying get the dust off the camera with the sun being out for a good bit at the start and need some new photos for the flyers. As always respect the spot, it's been weeks since I've been able to come out and don't want to show up just to see some ding dongs being ding dongs ruining it.

Keep in mind that being around in ice cream establishment there are going to be children so please remain respectful! Hope to see you all out there this week.

No Revving - No Burnouts - No Loud Music. Pick-up after yourself. Hope to see you all there.
